items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: She used to call her husband Sunk, you know, from the Lickman.

ctx.x: I said, no, ma'am. She said, well, we taught you how to read like that.

I said, play school with the children in the neighborhood. She said, she got the Prima. I read all through the Prima. She used to call her husband Sunk, you know, from the Lickman. She said, Sunk, come here. He said, uh, I used to call her. Oh, Lord, I can't, I feel you or something like that. He said, I'm busy with a class over here. She said, but come here, I want you to see this. He came on over. And, uh, she said, this boy, his mother says he never went to school. He claims he never went to school. I just…
Well, at your age, a good thing you did that.
